title: Onslaught
description: Call of Duty-style arena FPS in the browser, built one-shot by Claude Fable 5.1 in Claude Code with zero external assets. Three weapons with distinct gunplay (VK-7 full-auto with a parallax-free red dot, Hammer-12 pump shotgun, Longshot DMR with iron sights), spring-based weapon inertia and sway, CoD-style recoil patterns, ADS, sprint and slide. Separate viewmodel render pass, HDR MSAA pipeline with 13-tap bloom, chromatic aberration, radial blur and ACES grading. Hordes rendered as instanced procedural rigs with hit-flash and dissolve shaders, GPU-analytic particles, tracers, decals, shell casings, and fully synthesized WebAudio gunshots and music.
